title: Single cell atlas of canine natural killer cells identifies distinct circulating and tissue resident gene profiles.
reason: Multi-sample (9 canine tissues from multiple donors), multi-tissue, cross-species, with batch correction using Harmony, making it ideal for integration benchmarking.
methods_summary: scRNA-seq of CD45+ cells from dog blood, lung, liver, spleen, placenta using 10X Genomics v3.1; CellRanger alignment to CanFam3.1; Seurat processing with Harmony integration, Monocle3 pseudotime.
